bio.text: Kelley Dennison is the Republican Party nominee for Colorado's 2nd Congressional District in 2026, challenging Democratic Rep. Joe Neguse.
The Estes Valley Voice describes her as a 27-year-old Estes Park native and a licensed massage therapist who runs her own private practice.
According to the same report, she briefly attended college before completing more than 1,200 hours of massage therapy training.

sources.title: At 27, Estes Park's Dennison brings an unconventional face to Colorado GOP politics
